description: Writes SEO-friendly, accessible alt text for one image that is available at a public http(s) URL. The image address is sent to the AltTextGeneratorAI service, which downloads the image. Uses 1 credit.

image_url.description: Public address of the image (http or https).

language.description: Language of the alt text, in English, for example spanish, french, german or japanese. Defaults to english. 130+ languages are supported.

name: generate_alt_text
title: Generate alt text from an image URL
